phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Lee-Enfield No.4(T) Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the .303 British (7.7×56mmR) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 365 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 365 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 640 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 5-groove bore and accelerates to 744 m/s (3120 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Manual Bolt Cycle & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 10-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Lee-Enfield No.4(T) staged for its 25 RPM (Ultra-Fast 60° Bolt Throw) cadence.

zh.headline: 李-恩菲尔德 No.4 Mk I (T) 栓动狙击步枪：1941 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 李-恩菲尔德 No.4 Mk I (T) 由伦敦顶级手工枪匠霍兰德-霍兰德逐支手工调校枪托床衬、加装木质贴腮垫与 No.32 3.5 倍光学镜；凭借 60° 短转角推栓待击与 10 发双排弹匣，成为二战射速最快、最精密的制式狙击步枪之一。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Lee-Enfield No.4(T) 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1941 年问世的 李-恩菲尔德 No.4 Mk I (T) 栓动狙击步枪 由英国皇家兵工厂 / 霍兰德-霍兰德（Holland & Holland）主导研制，定位为经典的快栓 10 发栓动狙击步枪。No.4 Mk I (T) 在二战与朝鲜战争表现极为出色，战后改膛 7.62×51mm NATO 演变为 L42A1 并一直服役至 1990 年代初才被 L96/AWM 接替。
李-恩菲尔德 No.4 Mk I (T) 由伦敦顶级手工枪匠霍兰德-霍兰德逐支手工调校枪托床衬、加装木质贴腮垫与 No.32 3.5 倍光学镜；凭借 60° 短转角推栓待击与 10 发双排弹匣，成为二战射速最快、最精密的制式狙击步枪之一。 整件装备总长 1,129 mm（全包核桃木护木 + 木质贴腮垫）、空重 4.65 kg，成为同期狙击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1941 年，英国皇家兵工厂 / 霍兰德-霍兰德（Holland & Holland）推出了划时代的李-恩菲尔德 No.4 Mk I (T) 栓动狙击步枪。No.4 Mk I (T) 在二战与朝鲜战争表现极为出色，战后改膛 7.62×51mm NATO 演变为 L42A1 并一直服役至 1990 年代初才被 L96/AWM 接替。 它的核心设计聚焦于后置闭锁突笋实现仅 60° 极短开栓转角与推栓待击，创造“疯狂一分钟”传奇射速，奠定了其在狙击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 李-恩菲尔德 No.4 Mk I (T) 栓动狙击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「旋转后拉式栓动 · 60° 短转角推栓待击 + 10 发双排弹匣」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，射手手动旋转枪机手柄使刚性闭锁突笋脱槽，向后抽抛并推进新弹入膛，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托精加工而成。伦敦霍兰德-霍兰德手工精配 No.32 瞄准镜座与木床应力点，确保零点长久稳固，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。李-恩菲尔德 No.4 Mk I (T) 栓动狙击步枪 采用旋转后拉式栓动 · 60° 短转角推栓待击 + 10 发双排弹匣。在每个击发周期中，射手手动旋转枪机手柄使刚性闭锁突笋脱槽，向后抽抛并推进新弹入膛。借助发蓝锻钢与油润精选胡桃木/桦木托工艺与高强度配合，实现了伦敦霍兰德-霍兰德手工精配 No.32 瞄准镜座与木床应力点，确保零点长久稳固。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 .303 British (7.7×56mmR) 弹药规格与 640 mm 重型管 · 5 条左旋恩菲尔德膛线（1:254 mm 缠距），最高工作膛压约 365 MPa，可赋予弹头 744 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,120 J 动能，有效作用距离达 800 米。
内膛技术特点方面，标志性 5 条左旋（LH）恩菲尔德膛线配奇偶非对称阳线，抗铅铜挂垢且精度极佳。同时，10 发双排交错弹匣容量为同期 5 发栓动狙击枪的两倍，支持双桥夹快装，令其在 25 发/分（60° 极速推栓上膛） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 640 毫米身管与 .303 British (7.7×56mmR) 口径，李-恩菲尔德 No.4 Mk I (T) 栓动狙击步枪 实现了每秒 744 米的初速与 800 米有效射程。标志性 5 条左旋（LH）恩菲尔德膛线配奇偶非对称阳线，抗铅铜挂垢且精度极佳，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 10 发容量的10 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 36 mm 膛轴设计，李-恩菲尔德 No.4 Mk I (T) 栓动狙击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 10.8 N·s 水平。罕见的 5 条左旋（LH）恩菲尔德膛线与重型自由枪管带来卓越 800 m 精度。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Lee-Enfield No.4(T)
paragraphs: Introduced in 1941 by Royal Ordnance Factory / Holland & Holland in United Kingdom, the Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I (T) emerged as a defining Fast-Bolt 10-Round Sniper Rifle. So accurate was the No.4 Mk I (T) that Britain converted surviving rifles to 7.62×51mm NATO as the L42A1, keeping the lineage in front-line sniper service until the early 1990s.

Hand-bedded and converted in London by bespoke gunmaker Holland & Holland with a matched No.32 telescope and wooden cheekpiece, the Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I (T) combined a rapid 60° cock-on-closing bolt with a 10-round magazine. Measuring 1,129 mm (Full Walnut Stock & Cheekpiece) at an unloaded weight of 4.65 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Sniper Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1941, Royal Ordnance Factory / Holland & Holland of United Kingdom introduced the Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I (T). So accurate was the No.4 Mk I (T) that Britain converted surviving rifles to 7.62×51mm NATO as the L42A1, keeping the lineage in front-line sniper service until the early 1990s. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Rear-locking 60° bolt throw and cock-on-closing geometry enabled unmatched manual cycling speed — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I (T) sits its Turn-Bolt Action · 60° Cock-on-Closing Rear-Locking Bolt & 10-Round Detachable Magazine. Throughout every firing cycle, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering, containing 365 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Hand-fitted by Holland & Holland with serialized No.32 optics and precision-bedded walnut stocks, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I (T) relies on Turn-Bolt Action · 60° Cock-on-Closing Rear-Locking Bolt & 10-Round Detachable Magazine. During each cycle, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering. Machined from blued forged ordnance steel paired with oil-finished walnut, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Hand-fitted by Holland & Holland with serialized No.32 optics and precision-bedded walnut stocks.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for .303 British (7.7×56mmR) with 640 mm Heavy Barrel · 5-Groove LH Enfield Rifling (1:254 mm Twist), the Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I (T) develops 744 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,120 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 800 meters.

Internally, Iconic 5-groove left-hand (LH) Enfield rifling minimizes bullet jacket deformation and fouling. Combined with its 25 RPM (Ultra-Fast 60° Bolt Throw) tempo, 10-round double-stack magazine doubled the capacity of contemporary 5-round bolt snipers, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving .303 British (7.7×56mmR) through its 640 millimeter bore, the Lee-Enfield No.4 Mk I (T) achieves 744 meters per second and 800 meters of effective reach. Iconic 5-groove left-hand (LH) Enfield rifling minimizes bullet jacket deformation and fouling.
